name: @mitre/heimdall-lite
description: Heimdall is a JavaScript based security results viewer and review tool supporting multiple security results formats, such as: InSpec, SonarQube, OWASP-Zap, and Fortify which you can load locally or from S3 and other data sources.

scripts.prepack: vue-cli-service build --dest dist && cp ../../README.md README.md && cp package.json package.json.orig && cat package.json.orig | jq '.dependencies = (.dependencies | with_entries(select(.key | contains("express"))))' > package.json
